greet.speaker: Lola Pacita
greet.line: Apo! Diyos ko, lumaki ka na. Lumapit ka nga sa akin.
greet.line_en: Child! My goodness, you've grown. Come closer.

hug.speaker: Lola Pacita
hug.line: Mabigat ka pa rin kahit payat. Nahulog yata ang bagahe mo sa dalawang kalsada. Pasok ka na, umuulan nga pala kagabi, basa pa ang eskalera.
hug.line_en: Still heavy for someone so thin. Looks like your bag survived two highways. Come in — it rained last night, the steps are still wet.

warn_rain.speaker: Lola Pacita
warn_rain.line: Sa Daet, umuulan nang walang tanong. Lagi kang may dala ng chinelas. Payong din kung puwede.
warn_rain.line_en: In Daet, the rain doesn't ask. Always carry slippers. An umbrella too, if you can.

offer_food.speaker: Lola Pacita
offer_food.line: Nagluto ako ng adobong manok. Hinati ko sa dalawa — isa para sa iyo, isa para kay Lolo mo. Pero madalas, hindi na kumakain si Lolo. Napatatawa pa ba kayong dalawa?
offer_food.line_en: I made chicken adobo. Split it in two — one for you, one for Lolo. But often, your Lolo doesn't eat. Can you two still make each other laugh?

ask_choice.speaker: Apo
ask_choice.line: Salamat, Lola. Matagal na akong hindi nakakapunta rito. Kumusta ba kayo?
ask_choice.line_en: Thank you, Lola. It's been a long time. How have you both been?

choices.text_en: The photos on the wall — who are they?
Is there an old room here?

about_lolo.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_lolo.line: Nasa hapag si Lolo mo. Hindi tulog, hindi gising. Mga lalaking matanda... minsan hindi nila alam kung saan sila dapat tumingin. Baka kapag ikaw ang kaharap, matingnan niya ulit ang mga tao.
about_lolo.line_en: Lolo is at the table. Not asleep, not awake. Old men... sometimes they don't know where they should be looking. Maybe when you're across from him, he'll look at people again.

about_photos.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_photos.line: Pamilya natin lahat 'yan. Ang nasa gilid, mga pinsan ng Lolo mo. Ang nasa gitna... iyong batang babae... iniligpit ko sana 'yung litrato na 'yon. Lumang araw na.
about_photos.line_en: That's all our family. On the edges, Lolo's cousins. In the middle... the little girl... I should have put that photo away. Old days.

deflect_girl.speaker: Lola Pacita
deflect_girl.line: ...Ibang pamilya. Isinama lang sa larawan noong Pasko. Hindi natin kakilala. Isa pa, nabasa ko sa diyaryo kahapon na may bagyo na parating. Mag-iingat ka sa labas.
deflect_girl.line_en: ...Another family. Just added to the photo at Christmas. We don't know them. Besides, I read in the paper yesterday a storm is coming. Be careful outside.

about_room.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_room.line: Pakinggan mo ako, apo. May isang silid dito sa tabi ng pasilyo. Nakakandado. 'Wag mong buksan. Pangako mo sa akin, kahit anong marinig mo mamayang gabi.
about_room.line_en: Listen to me, apo. There is a room by the hallway. It is locked. Do not open it. Promise me — no matter what you hear tonight.

flashlight.speaker: Lola Pacita
flashlight.line: Mabuti. Dito, kunin mo ang flashlight ko. Pinalitan ko ng bagong baterya. Nawawala ang kuryente kapag umuulan — matagal na 'yan, sanay na kami, pero ikaw hindi.
flashlight.line_en: Good. Here, take my flashlight. I put in a fresh battery. Power goes out when it rains — that's been happening for years, we're used to it, you aren't.

end.speaker: Lola Pacita
end.line: Pumasok ka na. Tingnan mo ang sala — may kape at biskwit. Mag-usap kayo ni Lolo mo pagkatapos. Pagka gabi na, dumiretso ka sa iyong silid at matulog. Pangako.
end.line_en: Come inside. Have a look at the sala — there's coffee and biscuits. Talk to Lolo after. When night comes, go straight to your room and sleep. Promise.
